answer: Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 4 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. Histories are stored in delta, checked in signal, and zephyr publishes each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases because the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. A farm of 1108 identities would post 4619 proofs and burn roughly 50 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
